svg.title: Processing pipeline
svg.desc: Sources are ingested into documents and split into sentences. A local LLM gives each sentence one aspect from the ten found by offline discovery. Each sentence and aspect pair is scored by the fine-tuned model in use and by base FinBERT, both stored, and aggregated into an index for each model. The API serves the model in use, with the evidence, to the dashboard and the chatbot. Bank entity recognition is built but not applied.
